info.title: Dragon Math API
info.description: The routes the Dragon Academy iOS app uses. Generated from server/contracts/ by `npm run openapi`; do not edit by hand.

match_id.description: The id the device minted for this match; match_started and match_ended share it.

SyncMatchStartedPayload.description: kind `match_started`. occurred_at is when the battle began.

match_id.description: The id the device minted for this match; match_started and match_ended share it.

SyncMatchEndedPayload.description: kind `match_ended`. occurred_at is when it resolved. A finished match keeps its result, except that a real result replaces `incomplete`.

node_id.description: Story node, or 0 for practice games.

outcome.description: Who got the problem: the kid, or the opponent.

time_ms.description: How long the answer took, in milliseconds.
How long the answer took, in milliseconds.

SyncWrongTapPayload.description: kind `wrong_tap`: a wrong answer the kid tapped.

SyncNodeWonPayload.description: kind `node_won`. The best stars and the first completion are kept, in whatever order wins arrive.

dragon_ids.description: Dragons won; repeat an id to award it twice. Ids not in the catalog are skipped.

minutes.description: Consecutive active minutes starting at occurred_at.

SyncPlaytimePayload.description: kind `playtime`: minutes the kid was actively playing.

elapsed_ms.description: The run's finish time in milliseconds.

SyncProvingMedalPayload.description: kind `proving_medal`: one medal-winning Proving Grounds run (no-medal runs are not sent). occurred_at is when it was earned. Every run is kept; the best medal and time per level are read across them.

target_node_id.description: Where the trial placed the kid; must be a node in the node config.

per_op.description: Results for add, sub, mul and div.

SyncTrialCompletedPayload.description: kind `trial_completed`: the kid finished the Dragon's Trial placement test (docs/TRIAL.md). As POST /api/dragon-trial/complete: every node before the target counts as won with 3 stars and the summary is saved; the frontier moves to the target unless the kid is already further. occurred_at is when it was taken; an older take never replaces a newer summary.

SyncTelemetryKind.description: Sync kinds that are telemetry, not progress, as are all kinds starting `telemetry.`. For a child whose parent turned telemetry off, the server acknowledges them as `skipped` without storing them, and the device should not send them at all.

SyncCompanionChosenPayload.description: kind `companion_chosen`: the companion the kid takes into battle. The one chosen latest (by occurred_at) is active, in whatever order choices arrive; choosing one also befriends it.

font.description: A font theme id from src/data/fontThemes.js, as PUT /api/auth/profile takes.

SyncFontChosenPayload.description: kind `font_chosen`: the font theme the kid picked in Settings (users.font, which the web reads). The one chosen latest (by occurred_at) is theirs, in whatever order choices arrive.

body.description: The passage's body exactly as practised.

updated_at.description: The passage's updated_at (ISO 8601) exactly as the server sent it: which revision was practised.

SyncMemorizeProgressPayload.description: kind `memorize_progress`: a whole passage completed at one difficulty. The hardest level and the latest practice are kept, in whatever order completions arrive. Rejected (`passage_changed`) when the passage was edited since, as an edit resets mastery; `unknown_passage` when it is gone or not this child's.

element_key.description: The sound asked: a key from src/data/phonicsCurriculum.js ('sh', 'short-a', 'end-nk').

chosen.description: For a wrong answer, the element key it named; null otherwise. Not a key: stored as null.

response_ms.description: From the sound finishing to the answer, in milliseconds. Negative or over 120000: stored as null.

SyncPhonicsAttemptPayload.description: kind `phonics_attempt`: one Dragon Phonics question answered, as a row of POST /api/phonics/attempts. occurred_at is when it was answered. Progress, not telemetry: phonics mastery is judged from these rows.

SyncGameScorePayload.description: kind `game_score`: one finished arcade run (Dragon Munchers), the row POST /api/leaderboard/{game} writes. occurred_at is when the game ended. Every run is kept; the leaderboard reads each kid's best. Rejected (`game_locked`) when the child's plan does not include the game.

effective_plan.description: Highest plan among the child's guardians: free, premium or classroom.

family_mode.description: Present and true when the session came from a shared family device.

games_locked.description: Game ids (src/data/games.js) the child cannot open on their plan.

email.description: The login email. For a Sign in with Apple account it may be a private relay address.

contact_email.description: Where progress digests and COPPA notices go. Null until the parent sets one.

error.description: Human-readable message, safe to show a kid or parent.

token.description: JWT for the Authorization: Bearer header. Valid for 30 days.
The login token from a /k/<token> link or QR code.

child_id.description: Id of a child linked to the family.

token.description: The family token from a family-device link.

child_id.description: Id of a child linked to the family.

identity_token.description: The identityToken from ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential, as a string.

nonce.description: The RAW nonce. The authorization request must have carried its SHA-256 as lowercase hex; the server checks the token's nonce claim against that hash.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: At least one field is required.

verification_sent.description: True when a confirmation link was just emailed to user.contact_email. False when the address was already verified, so nothing needed sending.

email.description: Where progress emails should go. Not an Apple private relay address.

verified.description: Which address the link proved: email (the login email) or contact_email.

schema_version.description: Shape of this document. Bumped only for a breaking change; new sections and fields are not breaking.

version.description: Hash of the content. Changes whenever any value does; compare to a cached copy.

grid_size.description: Battle grid is grid_size × grid_size cells (2–10).

ops.description: Operations this node draws problems from: add, sub, mul, div.

ai_seconds.description: The opponent's base seconds per solve on this node.

shape_id.description: Grid shape id, or null for a plain square grid.

jitter_fraction.description: Solve delay is ai_seconds × 1000 jittered by ±(jitter_fraction / 2).

min_delay_ms.description: The opponent never solves faster than this.

grid_blank_ms.description: Grid blank time after the child solves a problem.

grid_blank_ai_ms.description: Grid blank time after the opponent solves one.

grid_lock_ms.description: How long a wrong tap locks the grid.

wrong_flash_ms.description: How long the tapped wrong cell flashes.

RarityWeights.description: Relative draw weight per rarity. Only rarities with dragons in the catalog are drawn; a rarity not listed weighs 1.

normal.description: The default, and any unknown tier.

PrizeCountWeights.description: How many dragons a prize holds, per performance tier, as weighted counts walked in order.

max_wrong_for_bronze.description: Slips bronze allows; gold and silver need a perfect run.

baseline_per_op.description: Baseline problems per op (add, sub, mul, div).

probe_uncertain.description: Probe problems for an op whose baseline is uncertain.

probe_confirm.description: Probe problems for an op whose baseline is strong.

probe_strong_min_score.description: Baseline score at or above which an op is strong.

probe_weak_below_score.description: Baseline score below which an op is weak (no further probes).

range_min.description: Operand range every trial problem draws from.

unique_retries.description: Tries for a problem not asked yet before accepting a repeat.

max_attempts.description: Wrong taps that resolve a problem at 0 points.

speed_bands.description: First band whose max_ms the answer time is within.

all_mastered_node.description: Placement node when add, sub and mul are all fluent.

max_ms.description: Upper bound (inclusive) on ms from display to the correct tap; null = no limit.

TrialBandMinScores.description: Lowest normalized score (0–1000) per confidence band; below emerging is not_ready.

TrialOpStartNodes.description: Placement node for a kid whose first unmastered op is this one.

easy_max_base.description: Bases up to this are worth easy_points a correct answer; above, hard_points.

enemy_telegraph_ms.description: How long a monster faces its next cell before stepping.

caught_beat_ms.description: The gobble beat before a caught muncher loses a life.

chase_chance.description: Share of moves (0–1) where a monster chases rather than wanders.

progression_hard.description: Campaign bases played after the easy ones, shuffled.

hint_delay_min_ms.description: A hint is offered hint_delay_min_ms + random × hint_delay_spread_ms in.

EggTierSeconds.description: Seconds UNDER which each tier is earned; slower than silver is bronze.

choices_per_hop.description: Lily pads offered per hop, the right one included.

easy_hide_every.description: Easy hides word i of sentence s when (i + s) % easy_hide_every === easy_hide_offset.

spelling_lists.description: Hash of GET /api/spelling/lists?child_id=… as this caller sees it.

ChildContentVersions.description: One child's content versions: sent for a child session, or for a grown-up who passes a linked child_id.

catalog.description: Every non-retired dragon, in dragon_id order.

total_dragons.description: Length of catalog, for the "X / total collected" headline.

count.description: How many of this dragon the child has caught.

first_acquired_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the first catch.

name.description: Null when the dragon is not in the catalog.

rarity.description: common, uncommon, rare, very_rare, legendary or mythic.
common, uncommon, rare, very_rare, legendary or mythic.

art_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of GET /api/dragons/art/{dragon_id}; null when the dragon has no art yet.

art_bytes.description: Size of that PNG in bytes; null with art_sha256.

dragons.description: Every non-retired dragon, in dragon_id order.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Changes on every edit.

created_by_self.description: True when the caller made the list (false: "added by a grown-up").

words.description: Lower-case words, in the order the list was typed.

audio_missing.description: Words with no recorded clip; their audio URL 404s.

example_sentences.description: Word → a sentence using it, for the words that have one.

category.description: What kind of text it is, verse, poem, quote, speech, definition or other.

body.description: The text to learn, exactly as the grown-up entered it.

mastery_level.description: Hardest level practised: 0 none, 1 easy, 2 medium, 3 hard.

last_practiced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, or null if never practised.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last edit; identifies the revision a practice session was of.

results.description: One per event, in request order.

index.description: Position of the event in the request.

id.description: The event id as sent, or null when it had none.

status.description: applied (written), stored (kept, kind not applied yet), duplicate (already received), skipped (telemetry for a child opted out of it; dropped unread, see SyncTelemetryKind), rejected (will never be accepted; see reason), failed (server error; resend later). A string rather than an enum so a new status cannot break an older app — act on `acknowledged`.

acknowledged.description: True when the server is done with this event and the device may delete it. Only `failed` is false.

reason.description: For skipped, rejected and failed: a stable code (telemetry_opt_out, invalid_event, invalid_payload, not_your_child, id_conflict, not_your_match, unknown_dragons, unknown_passage, passage_changed, unknown_node, game_locked, invalid_data, server_error).

message.description: For rejected and failed: human-readable detail.

SyncEventsRequest.description: 1–100 events, oldest first by convention; any order is accepted.

id.description: Minted on the device; the dedupe key. Never reuse one.

child_id.description: Whose event this is. A kid session may only send its own id; a grown-up, a linked child.

kind.description: One of match_started, match_ended, attempt, wrong_tap, node_won, dragons_collected, playtime, proving_medal, companion_chosen, font_chosen, memorize_progress, trial_completed, phonics_attempt, game_score; any other kind is stored but not applied.

occurred_at.description: When it happened on the device. A time in the future is recorded as now.

payload.description: The kind-specific fields — see the Sync*Payload schemas.

current_node_id.description: The map frontier: the furthest node unlocked.

nodes.description: Every node won, in node_id order.

dragons.description: Every dragon caught, in dragon_id order.

telemetry_opt_out.description: The parent turned this child's telemetry off: don't upload SyncTelemetryKind events for them.

SyncProgressResponse.description: Everything the server has recorded for the child, from every device. Includes every event acknowledged before this was read.

stars.description: Best stars earned on the node, 0–3.

count.description: How many of this dragon the child has caught, on every device.

plan.description: The plan in effect: free, premium or classroom. Highest grant wins.

source.description: Where the grant comes from: stripe, app_store, comp, manual or classroom. Null on free.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. expires_at of the winning grant.

grants.description: Every paid grant in effect, best first. For a child, those of all their guardians.

app_account_token.description: UUID to pass as StoreKit's appAccountToken when this parent buys, so the App Store subscription is credited to this account. Null for kids.

source.description: Where the grant comes from: stripe, app_store, comp, manual or classroom.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. When the grant ends or next renews; null when it does not expire.

will_renew.description: Whether it renews at expires_at; null when unknown or not applicable.

games_locked.description: Game ids (src/data/games.js) locked on this plan.

child_limit.description: Children an adult on this plan may have; null = unlimited.

username.description: The handle, or a placeholder while needs_handle is true (show real_name or a generic label instead).

last_attempt_at.description: ISO timestamp of the latest play; null if never.

telemetry_opt_out.description: True when the parent turned telemetry off: the app syncs only progress for this child.

username.description: Null: the child picks their own handle on first sign-in.

login_token.description: Secret for the /k/<login_token> sign-in link and QR code.

error.description: Human-readable message, safe to show a parent.

plan.description: The parent's plan in effect: free, premium or classroom.

limit.description: Children allowed on that plan; null = unlimited.

real_name.description: The child's name as the parent knows them. Adult-facing; empty or absent leaves it unset.

telemetry_opt_out.description: True turns this child's telemetry off; false turns it back on.

ChildSummaryResponse.description: One child's stats from everything the server has recorded, on every device — offline play counts once it has synced.

minutes_today.description: Active minutes on the server's local calendar day.

minutes_7d.description: Active minutes today and the six days before it.

last_played_at.description: ISO timestamp of the latest play; null if never.

current_node_id.description: The map frontier: the furthest node unlocked.

stars.description: Best stars summed over every node won (up to 3 each).

window_days.description: The rolling window these figures cover.

min_attempts.description: Answers an operation needs to be called strongest or weakest.

operators.description: Each operation practised in the window.

strongest.description: Best operation by accuracy, then pace; null without enough play.

weakest.description: Least accurate operation; null unless worse than the strongest.

avg_child_ms.description: Average time to a solve; null with no solves.

accepted.description: Always true on 202: the device may delete its copy.

id.description: Minted on the device for this report; a resend with the same id is stored once. Mint a fresh one per report — never reuse one as a device or install identifier.

kind.description: metric: an MXMetricPayload. diagnostic: an MXDiagnosticPayload.

app_version.description: The app version and build, e.g. "1.0 (42)".

payload.description: The payload's jsonRepresentation(), as MetricKit produced it.

MetricKitUploadRequest.description: One MetricKit report. The whole request body is at most 256 KB.

deleted_child_ids.description: Children deleted with the account: they had no other parent.

unlinked_child_ids.description: Children kept because another parent is linked to them; this parent is only unlinked.

apple_token_revoked.description: Whether the Sign in with Apple grant was revoked. False when the server is not configured for it or Apple refused; the parent can still remove the app under Settings > Apple Account.

identity_token.description: A FRESH identityToken from ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential. Its sub must be the signed-in parent's Apple ID: re-authenticating is the confirmation.

nonce.description: The RAW nonce, as for POST /api/auth/apple.

authorization_code.description: The same credential's authorizationCode. The server trades it for a token and revokes it, ending this app's Sign in with Apple grant. Without it the account is still deleted.
